useCases.title: Document intake and routing
useCases.problem: Staff manually sort emailed forms, invoices, and attachments.
useCases.approach: Classify documents and route draft records for review.
useCases.example: A finance team checks extracted invoice details before entry.
useCases.review: Staff approve uncertain fields and protect customer records.
useCases.measure: Track handling time, corrections, and routing exceptions.

useCases.title: Customer query triage
useCases.problem: Repeated questions delay replies to complex customer needs.
useCases.approach: Group queries and suggest replies from approved information.
useCases.example: Staff review draft answers about delivery or returns.
useCases.review: Staff own complaints, data requests, and uncertain cases.
useCases.measure: Track response time, corrections, and unresolved queries.

useCases.title: Booking reminders and rescheduling
useCases.problem: Staff manually remind clients and refill cancelled slots.
useCases.approach: Prepare reminders and rescheduling steps from approved rules.
useCases.example: A clinic directs patients to its booking channel.
useCases.review: Check consent, wording, access, and contact preferences.
useCases.measure: Track staff time, failures, and rescheduled appointments.

useCases.title: Lead and customer record completion
useCases.problem: Staff copy enquiry details across incomplete customer records.
useCases.approach: Suggest updates from authorised sources for staff review.
useCases.example: Review a draft record from an enquiry form.
useCases.review: Retain source links; approve records before outreach.
useCases.measure: Track completeness, duplicates, corrections, and preparation time.

useCases.title: Price-change review support
useCases.problem: Price updates are scattered across notices and spreadsheets.
useCases.approach: Collect permitted changes and flag them for review.
useCases.example: A manager checks supplier updates before changing prices.
useCases.review: Managers decide; suggestions never change prices automatically.
useCases.measure: Track review time, corrections, and accepted suggestions.

useCases.title: Invoice processing support
useCases.problem: Staff read invoices, match records, and retype details.
useCases.approach: Extract fields and suggest matches; flag exceptions.
useCases.example: An administrator checks a draft against its purchase order.
useCases.review: Authorised staff retain approval and payment decisions.
useCases.measure: Track processing time, corrections, matches, and exceptions.

useCases.title: Management reporting preparation
useCases.problem: Managers gather figures and reconcile separate tools manually.
useCases.approach: Show approved data, source, refresh time, and draft narrative.
useCases.example: An operations lead reviews work and exception dashboards.
useCases.review: Owners verify definitions, totals, access, and context.
useCases.measure: Track report time, freshness, reconciliation, and corrections.

useCases.title: Supplier order administration
useCases.problem: Staff copy order details and chase confirmations manually.
useCases.approach: Prepare draft orders and flag missing supplier replies.
useCases.example: A coordinator checks an event order before sending.
useCases.review: Buyers approve terms; connections depend on available access.
useCases.measure: Track preparation time, delays, corrections, and open requests.

useCases.title: Stock and demand review
useCases.problem: Staff manually compare stock, sales, and lead times.
useCases.approach: Display agreed signals and prepare reorder suggestions.
useCases.example: An owner checks low-stock items before ordering.
useCases.review: Owners decide, accounting for seasonality and data gaps.
useCases.measure: Track review time, discrepancies, urgent orders, and decisions.

useCases.title: Staff schedule preparation
useCases.problem: Managers reconcile availability and coverage across messages.
useCases.approach: Summarise availability and flag possible shift gaps.
useCases.example: A manager reviews a draft rota and conflicts.
useCases.review: Managers decide, checking rules, fairness, and preferences.
useCases.measure: Track rota time, uncovered shifts, changes, and corrections.

useCases.title: Contract review preparation
useCases.problem: Reviewers locate key terms and compare internal requirements.
useCases.approach: Extract selected clauses into an approved comparison checklist.
useCases.example: A manager checks renewal dates and obligations with an adviser.
useCases.review: Qualified people verify text and make legal decisions.
useCases.measure: Track preparation time, missed fields, corrections.

useCases.title: Compliance evidence organisation
useCases.problem: Teams search for current policies and supporting records.
useCases.approach: Index approved documents with sources, dates, and review checklist.
useCases.example: A manager checks policies due for internal review.
useCases.review: Owners confirm requirements; this does not certify compliance.
useCases.measure: Track evidence search time, missing and stale records.

useCases.title: New-starter administration
useCases.problem: People teams coordinate forms, access, and introductions manually.
useCases.approach: Show approved onboarding tasks, owners, and completion status.
useCases.example: A coordinator checks equipment, induction, and forms.
useCases.review: People staff control sensitive data and employment decisions.
useCases.measure: Track completion time, overdue tasks, and missing items.

useCases.title: Internal knowledge search
useCases.problem: Staff search folders or ask colleagues for procedures.
useCases.approach: Search approved sources and link answers to documents.
useCases.example: A colleague opens the cited returns procedure before replying.
useCases.review: Restrict sources; route unanswered or conflicting questions.
useCases.measure: Track search time, source clicks, and reported corrections.

useCases.title: Clinician-reviewed draft documentation
useCases.problem: Clinicians spend time preparing routine draft documentation.
useCases.approach: Prepare drafts from recorded information for clinician review.
useCases.example: A clinician edits an administrative letter before signing.
useCases.review: Clinicians check drafts; no diagnosis or treatment advice.
useCases.measure: Track editing time, omissions, corrections, and rejected drafts.

scenarios.title: Document collection in an accountancy practice
scenarios.before: Staff repeatedly request missing client records.
scenarios.after: Shared tracking; staff approve drafted reminders.
scenarios.inputs: Agree documents, contacts, owners, and access.
scenarios.review: Staff approve messages and resolve exceptions.
scenarios.measure: Track time, responses, corrections, and open requests.

scenarios.title: Status updates for conveyancing matters
scenarios.before: Staff answer repeat enquiries across matter records.
scenarios.inputs: Agree milestones, access, sharing rules, and owners.
scenarios.review: Legal staff verify facts before sending updates.
scenarios.measure: Track preparation time, repeat enquiries, and corrections.

scenarios.title: Administrative recall coordination
scenarios.before: Staff reconcile administrative lists across systems.
scenarios.after: Review one list and prepare approved invitations.
scenarios.inputs: Agree cohort, wording, access, preferences, escalation.
scenarios.review: Administrative only; clinicians own clinical decisions.
scenarios.measure: Track reconciliation, invitation status, handling, exceptions.

scenarios.title: Event close-out and invoice administration
scenarios.before: Event close-out details span inboxes and spreadsheets.
scenarios.after: Shared checklist prepares invoice requests for review.
scenarios.inputs: Agree records, sign-off, invoice fields, and owners.
scenarios.review: Staff verify details before invoice creation.
scenarios.measure: Track timing, missing details, corrections, open tasks.
